name: GPU Budget Negotiation Arena
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Five AI labs share a single GPU pool just before a paper deadline. They have hidden private utility, deadlines, budgets, reputations, and supply shocks. We trained Llama-3.2-3B with SFT + GRPO against the live environment reward and watched it flip two of three task means from negative to positive — overall reward jumping from −0.094 to +0.257, third out of eight evaluated policies. Every plot, every number, every transcript on the live Space comes from real artifacts in this repo.

The arena ships an OpenEnv-compatible HTTP contract, deterministic and reproducible world generation, a hybrid rule-judge layer for natural-language pitches, and an interactive web front end that renders every artifact produced by training and evaluation.
